title: Do not spend this rare life asleep
summary: A rare body becomes self-harm when Naam is absent from its center. Wake the soul before habit spends the life for you.
takeaway: Do not let a rare body sleep through the Naam it was given to remember.
lifeApplication: Interrupt one automatic comfort today with a clear return to Naam, even if it is brief and unadorned.

source.shortMeaning: The rare human body is harmed at the soul’s level when it refuses remembrance of Naam.
source.lifeApplication: Before drift becomes another evening, remember what this life was given for.

evidence.coreClaim: The rare human body is harmed at the soul’s level when it refuses remembrance of Naam.
evidence.turn: The shabad makes urgency compassionate by naming forgetfulness as danger before it becomes a whole life.
evidence.practicalImplication: Interrupt one automatic comfort today with a clear return to Naam, even if it is brief and unadorned.
